Ava Chen: 👋 quick heads-up — I need to swap out of tonight's primary shift, flight got delayed. Can someone take primary from 23:00–07:00 UTC? I'm happy to do a handoff now and leave the runbook + open pages.
Samir Patel: I can take primary from 23:00–03:00 UTC if that helps. Who can cover 03:00–07:00?
Ravi Kumar: I can pick up 03:00–07:00 UTC. Ava, do you want me to run through telemetry + active alerts before you leave? :thumbsup:
Ava Chen: Yes please — quick summary below.
Ava Chen: Active pages right now:
- incident: infra-token-hotloop (P2) — noisy retries from dedupe queue, rate ~12/s, started 22:15 UTC
- perf: embed-queue-lag (P3) — backlog growing in eu-west-1, not customer-facing yet
Ava Chen: Customer impact: no direct 5xxs observed; some timeouts on internal worker retries that can delay background jobs. I set rate limit patch on the worker group to reduce retry storm.
IncidentBot: [ALERT] 6249876512 infra-token-hotloop escalated to oncall (P2) — triggered 3x in 10m. Link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/6249876512
Samir Patel: Ok noted. Runbook steps I used are in the handoff doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff — see section "Retry storms".
Ravi Kumar: Can you paste the exact k8s command you ran? I want to be able to undo safely.
Ava Chen: Sure, command I used to set the env var on worker deployment:
```
kubectl -n services patch deployment worker-main -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"worker","env":[{"name":"RETRY_BACKOFF_MS","value":"2000"}]}]}}}}'
```
Ava Chen: That lowered retry velocity; queue ingress dropped from ~18/s to ~3/s over 5m. I also scaled the deduper to +1 replica temporarily.
Samir Patel: Thanks. I'll monitor logs and start a 30m watch. Ravi can you confirm you'll take the second half and have mobile up-to-date for pages?
Ravi Kumar: Mobile on. Pager channel subscribed. I'll take 03:00–07:00 UTC. I'll also shadow Samir for 15m prior to swap.
Lina Gomez: FYI, I pulled the latest incident dashboard and added a widget for 'deduper retry rate' so it's visible on the console page.
Samir Patel: Oncall handoff checklist: 1) confirm active pages cleared; 2) runbook link shared; 3) escalation contact set. Ava — did you set PagerDuty escalation to include Ravi at 03:00?
Ava Chen: Not yet — done now. PD schedule updated to add Ravi for 03:00 shift. pd-schedule update command: `pd schedule override --user ravi.kumar --start 2026-03-15T03:00Z --end 2026-03-15T07:00Z`.
IncidentBot: [NOTE] Oncall schedule change recorded (ID 8642) — Override by Ava Chen for ravi.kumar 03:00–07:00 UTC.
Samir Patel: Good. Small gap check: who will handle customer-facing comms if we need to page CS? Lina, is CS on rotation tonight?
Lina Gomez: CS is on standby till 02:00 UTC. After that, escalation to on-call CS will be via the standard channel. I added their duty roster to the runbook link.
Ava Chen: Quick risk notes for Ravi: don't revert the retry_backoff immediately to previous value — it may re-trigger the storm. If you need to revert, first scale down the ingress via the rate-limiter.
Ravi Kumar: Understood. I'll keep the backoff. If retries fall below 1/s and queue doesn't backfill, I'll incrementally lower backoff.
Samir Patel: During my watch I'll also keep an eye on embed-queue backlog — if it exceeds 10k items, we should open a P3 incident and coordinate a short throttle for background workers.
Ava Chen: Leaving a final checklist here:
- [x] Runbook link shared
- [x] PD override set for Ravi
- [x] k8s patch applied (RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=2000)
- [x] Deduper scaled +1
- [x] Dashboard widget added (Lina)
Samir Patel: I'm primary now, starting 23:00 UTC. Monitoring: logs, traces, deduper retry rate. Ping me if anything spikes.
Ravi Kumar: I'll shadow for 15m starting 02:45 UTC and take full primary at 03:00 UTC. Contact: +1-555-724-9901 (mobile). If I miss a page, call me.
Ava Chen: Thanks team. Flight check-in soon — leaving monitoring to you. :airplane:
IncidentBot: [INFO] 6249876543 Oncall handoff noted. Watchers: Samir Patel (primary 23:00–03:00), Ravi Kumar (primary 03:00–07:00). Handoff metadata saved.
Samir Patel: Quick note for post-shift: please add a short postmortem in /confluence/incidents if we end up toggling retry back to previous value — helps with tuning quantiles.
Lina Gomez: Will do. Also, tagging related alerts with `deduper-retry-backoff` for easier search.
Ravi Kumar: Confirmed final handoff at 03:00 — Samir, I'll DM right before to sync.
Samir Patel: Sounds good. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
